findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap within 2-3mm of U16 power pins.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (FPGA_SIGNAL_3V3) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J2

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (84×224mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 319 MHz; (0,2) at 638 MHz; (1,0) at 851 MHz; (1,1) at 909 MHz; (0,3) at 957 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Incomplete ground pour at board edges
findings.description: Ground pour covers ~60% of the board perimeter (50/124 sample points lack nearby ground zone). A continuous ground guard ring around the board perimeter reduces edge radiation. (Note: uses bounding box approximation.)
findings.recommendation: Add ground pour on outer layers extending to within 2mm of all board edges, connected by stitching vias.
findings.summary: Incomplete ground pour at board edges

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /DRV_VDD_A
findings.description: Net /DRV_VDD_A has 7 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 7 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /DRV_VDD_A
